text:
Maya (Docs): opened a small PR for quota/pricing docs to reflect meter renames and add a migration checklist -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/870
Samir (Eng): will review. does it map `tokens_consumed` -> `inference.tokens` and `billing_amount` -> `billing.usage_usd`? our billing jobs need that exact mapping.
Maya (Docs): yes, mapping table included and a short SQL snippet for reconciliation. also added note about new quota unit: token-minutes for bursty routes.
Eli (Platform): include the Grafana query for converting counts to a rate: `sum(rate(inference.tokens[1m]))` and add dashboard UID `usage_overview_v2` so SEs can import.
Ava (DevEx): please add Node + Python SDK examples. Node should use `meter.reportBatch()`, python uses `meter.report_batch()`. also include a tiny smoke script in examples/ that asserts 202 on success.
Samir (Eng): confirmed: Node is camelCase, python snake_case. reportBatch returns 202 Accepted on success; 400 for validation errors. i'll add an error payload example.
Jordan (PM): add a 60-day deprecation banner copy and a migration checklist at the top (inventory, map IDs to quota_tier, update dashboard queries, run staging billing, flip banner). include email cadence (30/14/7/1 days).
Maya (Docs): added banner text + checklist + proposed calendar. requesting reviews from @Samir @Eli @Ava so i can merge later today.
DocsBot: PR #870 updated: 4 files changed, 12 additions. CI: docs-build passed.
Samir (Eng): LGTM for snippets and mappings.
Eli (Platform): one tiny wording nit in the quota table (change "soft limit" -> "burstable soft limit"). after that i'll approve.
Maya (Docs): thanks! will push that wording fix now and merge once approved. :rocket:
